1. Prices are estimates for budgeting (2026-11). Every 'confirm' part number is checked against a quote before ordering; NORD frame and hollow bore set the shaft journal and the torque bracket.
2. Materials: product contact 316L (trough, cover, agitator; shaft 316); frame 304. Certs (EN 10204 3.1) required for all 316L plate and bar.
3. Weld consumables: ER316L Ø1.6 and Ø2.4 TIG rod, argon 99.996 %, back-purge for full-penetration joints; passivation gel or citric bath (ASTM A967).
